Solution B is more likely correct. Its claim that the smallest such pair has order 32 matches my recollection of the literature on isoclinism and conjugacy quandles, though I can't verify it here. Solution A's value of 64 is asserted without support, and I don't recall a result placing the first counterexample at 64.

Neither solution gives a verifiable argument, so this rests on recall rather than a check of the groups of order 32 or 64.

WINNER: B
